title: SSI Index — grid-geo.json (canonical schema)
description: Per-country grid topology: substations (dict keyed by OSM ID) and power lines (array). Canonical schema as of Phase 0a (KB §65). 29/32 countries conform exactly. Documented exceptions: denmark (additive line.n), slovenia (additive sub.r), greenland (deliberate islanded-grid alternate schema — not validated here).

s.description: Substations — dict keyed by OSM ID (string).

l.description: Power lines — array of canonical line objects.

a.description: Optional: adjacency lookup (substation_id → [line_id, ...]). May be empty.

substation.description: Required: x, y coordinates. Other fields are widely-present but not always (Canada has 1 substation without n; BE/LU/NL/CZ have substations with null voltage where OSM tag was missing).

n.description: Substation name (free text). May be missing (Canada) or null.

v.description: Max voltage in kV. null = unknown (OSM voltage tag missing); 0 = explicit zero placeholder.

i.description: Line ID (sequential or OSM way ID)

p.description: Geometry — array of [lon, lat] coord pairs
